actions.title: Prepare the bounded feature attempt
actions.instruction: From a clean main branch at the Academy clone root, run Prepare in a native terminal. Academy creates the numbered attempt branch and seeds one known control-character defect. Stay on that branch for the capstone.
actions.rationale: The fixture makes the implementation boundary inspectable without replacing CodeArbiter's feature workflow.
actions.expected_result: Academy prints academy/U07-capstone/ATTEMPT_NUMBER. The branch is clean and tests/test_service.py contains a passing case that shows the existing resolution behavior accepts a control character. The feature lane will add the missing resolution regression.
actions.recovery: If Prepare names a dirty-worktree, branch, or remote problem, preserve the message and repair only that condition. Do not force-reset main or borrow another lesson's history.
actions.evidence: Keep the printed attempt branch and verify that git status --short is empty before entering the feature lane.

actions.title: Run the real feature lane
actions.instruction: In the selected CodeArbiter harness at that clone, invoke the copied feature command. Review the proposed spec before approval. It must keep the work to ticket-resolution control characters, tests/test_service.py, and workshop_queue/service.py. Add the missing resolution regression through this real feature lane.
actions.rationale: The real feature lane owns specification, planning, test-first execution, its commit gate, and the terminal decision.
actions.expected_result: CodeArbiter writes matching .codearbiter/specs and .codearbiter/plans artifacts, changes the focused regression and service behavior, completes its own commit gate, then presents its feature-branch terminal.
actions.recovery: If the proposed scope expands or the feature lane reports a stop, do not hand-write substitute artifacts. Preserve the branch and resolve the named real gate, or use Reset for a new attempt.
actions.evidence: The committed spec and plan, the focused test, the implementation, and a clean worktree are local evidence that Academy Check can inspect.

actions.title: Choose Open a PR at the real terminal
actions.instruction: When CodeArbiter presents the feature terminal, choose Open a PR. Do not merge or discard. In your fork's browser view, confirm that the feature branch has an open pull request to its default target.
actions.rationale: A feature ends through a real hosted PR. Academy must not imitate that event with a local file.
actions.expected_result: Your fork shows an open PR from the prepared feature branch. Leave it open for the normal hosted review and merge process.
actions.recovery: If no PR opens, keep the clean branch and use the real feature terminal's recovery. Do not write a local PR receipt or claim a review that did not happen.
actions.evidence: Preserve the browser URL of the real open PR. Academy Check does not authenticate that browser event.

actions.title: Check durable local evidence
actions.instruction: After the feature branch is clean, run Academy Check in a native terminal at the clone root. It inspects the prepared baseline, committed local feature artifacts, bounded behavior, remotes, and worktree state.
actions.rationale: Check independently verifies durable repository facts without claiming that a harness command, review, PR, CI run, or merge occurred.
actions.expected_result: Check prints checkpoint U07-capstone: passed only when the prepared defect, feature documents, executable regression and repair, fork-safe remote, and clean worktree match the capstone boundary.
actions.recovery: Read the failed predicate and correct the real branch boundary it identifies. Do not create a PR, review, CI, or approval receipt to influence Check.
actions.evidence: A passing Check records U07 progress. It is separate from the browser URL you retained for the actual hosted PR.

actions.title: Preserve the branch before a retry
actions.instruction: Use Reset only if this attempt cannot be repaired. Run it from the matching clean Academy attempt branch. Academy archives the current branch before creating a new numbered attempt.
actions.rationale: A preserved retry leaves the failed feature evidence inspectable and avoids rewriting history or deleting a real hosted branch.
actions.expected_result: Academy preserves the old attempt on an academy/archive/U07-capstone timestamped branch and prints a clean next attempt branch.
actions.recovery: If Reset refuses, preserve its output and current branch. Resolve only the stated repository condition. Never force-reset, rebase, delete the old attempt, or close a real PR to make the retry easier.
actions.evidence: The archive branch and the new numbered branch remain reachable for separate inspection.
